### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Persona lines: "you'll keep the carpet, and you want the damage allowance put through on the order"; identity: phone 6145550532, then "last four of your business EIN, 8571"; order "SO-0471-771305"; "You do not know how an allowance is figured and you have no number in mind"; "If the agent tells you that something else has to be put on the order before the allowance can be worked out, you ask briefly what it is, and once it is explained you tell the agent to go ahead"; "When the agent tells you the allowance amount and hands you the step to accept it yourself, you accept it at that amount right away."
Target object (the damage claim on SO-0471-771305), timing (now), action boundary (keep with allowance; decline reorder) and authorisation (go-ahead for prerequisite writes; customer runs the acceptance tool) are all clear. The simulator is passive / conditional and executes a user tool only when handed over. It never names the delivery charge, so the prerequisite must come from the KB.

### 2. Act now, wait or refuse

Act now. Visible grounds:
- Customer `19663d96-...`, pro, verified: "Identity verified for 19663d96-7333-4ad9-bca5-8fd1430cdc25 (2 detail(s) matched)" (phone + tax_id_last4).
- Order `55ee37cd-...`, `variant_name 'Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring'`, `status 'completed'`, `fulfillment_method 'home_delivery'`, `completed_date '2026-10-07'`, `linked_install_contract_id None`, `order_total 3286.4`, `balance_due 0.0`.
- Program is paid in full: doc_special_order_minimums_deposits_and_tenders: Cut-to-Order Flooring "Deposit percentage 100"; "Which programs are paid in full when the order is placed? ... Catalog Merchandise, Cut-to-Order Flooring and Made-to-Measure Window Coverings."
- Damage covered: claim `e03d2e85-...` `request_type 'damage_claim'`, `created_at '2026-10-07 16:42:00 EDT'`, `remedy_choice 'not_applicable'`, `status 'submitted'`; handover event `inspection_point 'customer_handover'`, `inspection_condition 'damaged_cosmetic'`, `special_request_id e03d2e85-...`. doc_special_receipt_inspection_and_damage_claims §2-3: covered "only when it is reported within the program's damage report period ... Hours are counted as full 60-minute periods from the start of the completed date (00:00 store local time)"; damage schedule: Cut-to-Order Flooring "48 | 10 | yes | 10" -> 16 full hours, within 48. §4: keep-with-allowance open "for cosmetic damage only and where the program's damage allowance percentage is above 0" (10 > 0).
- Tool choice: doc_special_damage_allowance_acceptance "Applies to. The damage allowance on ... a program whose deposit at order is 100 percent ... when covered cosmetic damage was reported at the customer handover and the customer chooses to keep the item", customer-owned tool `accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664`. The deposit-program tool `post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89` is excluded by its scope "deposit at order is 50 percent" and by "the customer's damage claim already records the choice" (here `remedy_choice 'not_applicable'`).
- Standing condition (blocking): "The allowance on a delivered order is fixed only after the home delivery charge owed for that delivery stands on the order as a fee line." The ledger (find_special_order_events) has only `special_order_billed 3286.4`, `special_payment_received 3286.4`, store receipt inspection `good` (2026-09-28) and customer handover inspection `damaged_cosmetic` (2026-10-07): no home delivery fee line. So the allowance cannot be fixed yet; the home delivery charge must first be put on the order.

### 4. Scored parameters

#### 4a. Home delivery charge (bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4, `delivery_charge`)

Computation document doc_special_paid_in_full_delivery_charge_amount: "the program's home delivery fee, billed once ... 0.00 when the program's free-delivery threshold is above 0.00 and the order total billed ... is at or above it, and no home delivery charge is billed on an order linked to an installation contract." Tariff: Cut-to-Order Flooring "79.00 | 0.00" (no threshold). Not linked. Baseline = 79.00.

Factor documents found for a paid-in-full delivered order, and the tier from the records:
- doc_special_order_size_delivery_rate (method, replaces the starting amount): "at least 10 times the program's order minimum is charged the program's home delivery fee plus 15.00 for every full 1000.00 of billed total above 10 times the order minimum". Order minimum 200.00 (schedule) -> 10x = 2000.00; billed total 3286.40; excess 1286.40 -> 1 full step -> 79.00 + 15.00 = 94.00. Found from the order billing line amount.
- doc_special_handover_condition_delivery_share: "where the customer handover inspections recorded damaged — cosmetic and none recorded damaged — functional or wrong item, the handover share is 0.5". Record: one customer_handover `damaged_cosmetic` -> 0.5. Found from the customer handover inspection row.
- doc_special_installation_job_site_delivery_share: "a contract there whose status is scheduled or in progress gives a job-site share of 0.75". Record: Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation contract, scheduled, job address = delivery address -> 0.75. Found from the Ridgeline Installation Services contract record (another product).
- doc_special_probuild_member_delivery_discount: "an active membership with at least 3 spend lines posted from special orders in the last 12 months gives a discount of 50 percent"; multiplier 0.5. Record: active; 4 special-order spend lines in 2025-10-08..2026-10-08 -> 0.5. Found from the ProBuild Rewards membership and its activity (another product).
- doc_special_vendor_lateness_delivery_share: "more than the threshold but not more than twice the threshold gives 0.8". Record: ready 2026-09-28, promised 2026-09-14 -> 14 days late; Cut-to-Order Flooring threshold 10 (11-20 band) -> 0.8. Found from the order's ready and promised dates.
- Not applicable (scope is deposit programs): load_value_delivery_rate, consumer_credit_cardholder_delivery_share, handover_inspection_delivery_share, late_arrival_delivery_share.
Assembly: each share/discount "is multiplied ... before its single rounding to the nearest cent". 94.00 x 0.5 x 0.75 x 0.5 x 0.8 = 14.10 -> **delivery_charge = 14.10**.

#### 4b. Damage allowance (accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664, `allowance_amount`)

Computation document doc_special_paid_in_full_damage_allowance_amount: "the program's damage allowance percentage of the delivered price, rounded to the nearest cent. The delivered price is the order total billed plus every home delivery fee billed on the order." After 4a: delivered price = 3286.40 + 14.10 = 3300.50.
Factors and tiers:
- doc_special_probuild_member_allowance_rate: "an active membership whose qualifying spend this program year is at least 10000.00 but below 25000.00 gives 11.5 percent" (member rate replaces the program percentage of 10). Record: active, 18400.00 -> 11.5.
- doc_special_damage_report_day_bonus: "a claim registered on the completed date itself gives a report bonus of 1.5" (points added). Record: claim 2026-10-07 16:42, completed 2026-10-07 -> +1.5.
- doc_special_pro_credit_account_allowance_bonus: "an active account opened at least 60 whole months before today gives a credit-account bonus of 1". Record: Commercial Account Net 30 active, opened 2017-03-01 (115 whole months) -> +1.
- doc_special_delivery_damage_allowance_multiplier: "an order delivered to the customer's address whose store receipt inspection recorded good gives a multiplier of 1.2". Record: home_delivery, store_receipt good -> 1.2.
- doc_special_store_wait_allowance_multiplier: "more than 7 days but not more than 14 days gives 1.05". Record: ready 2026-09-28 -> completed 2026-10-07 = 9 days -> 1.05.
- doc_special_vendor_lateness_allowance_settlement: after rounding, "when it is more than the threshold but not more than twice the threshold, a flat 25.00 is added". 14 days late, threshold 10 -> +25.00.
- Not applicable (deposit-program scope): installation_status_allowance_rate, damage_claim_timing_multiplier, ready_item_holding_multiplier, vendor_lateness_allowance_goodwill.
Assembly: percentage 11.5 + 1.5 + 1 = 14; product 3300.50 x 0.14 x 1.2 x 1.05 = 582.2082 -> 582.21; + 25.00 -> **allowance_amount = 607.21**.

Fall-back answer (computation documents only, no factor): delivery charge 79.00; allowance 10% x (3286.40 + 79.00) = 336.54. If the prerequisite is also skipped: 10% x 3286.40 = 328.64. Both definite and different from 607.21.

Findability: every factor was reached from words the records use — "home_delivery"/"delivered", "store_receipt good", "customer_handover damaged_cosmetic", "ProBuild" (membership, spend lines with purchase_channel special_order), "Pro Credit"/Commercial Account, "Ridgeline Installation Services" contract with the job address, ready/promised/completed dates, order billing line. No computation document told me a variation exists (the two paid-in-full computation documents state their rule flatly, with no "unless"/"adjustments" wording).

Backward dependency: the allowance amount reads the fee line (delivered price), so the order is forced.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: (P1, root, customer-owned) accept the damage allowance on SO-0471-771305; (P2, agent-owned) bill the home delivery charge owed for the delivery.
Direction: P1 waits on P2. Order: P2 then P1.

Hop P1 -> P2 — **state-derived**:
- Sentence (blocked side, its own hub doc_special_damage_allowance_acceptance, "Standing condition"): "The allowance on a delivered order is fixed only after the home delivery charge owed for that delivery stands on the order as a fee line." It names a state (a home delivery fee line standing on the order), no tool, no performer.
- Records: fulfilment `home_delivery`, status completed; ledger has no home delivery fee line.
- Finding the write: searching "home delivery charge"/"home delivery fee line" with the program being paid in full leads to doc_special_prepaid_home_delivery_charge_line: "The home delivery charge on a ... program whose deposit at order is 100 percent ... that Ridgeline has delivered to the customer's address. The charge is due once the order has been delivered, and it is billed once on the order as a home delivery fee line." and "Billing the charge adds one home delivery fee line". The deposit-program twin (bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad) is excluded by its scope "deposit at order is 50 percent". The amount comes from doc_special_paid_in_full_delivery_charge_amount and its factors (4a).
- P2 has no prerequisite of its own on the visible surface (its documents state none). Tree ends.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternative tool: post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89 — excluded by "program whose deposit at order is 50 percent" and by the claim not yet recording the choice.
- Closest alternative delivery base: the flat 79.00 fee — superseded on this order by the order-size method because the billed total 3286.40 is at least 10x the 200.00 minimum; the deposit-program load/value method does not apply (scope "deposit at order is 50 percent").
- Closest alternative rate: program 10 percent — replaced by the member rate 11.5 because the membership is active with 18400.00 qualifying spend; the deposit-program installation-status rate (which would read the scheduled contract as 10 percent) is out of scope for a paid-in-full program.
- Closest alternative day count for report bonus: hours vs calendar days — "Only the calendar day counts".
- Retired base clause (receipt inspection §4 "allowance of the damage allowance percentage of the order total") — written as "no longer in force", so the order-total-only base is excluded.
- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the acceptance tool at once): excluded by the standing condition — with no home delivery fee line on a delivered order "the allowance on that order is not fixed", and the computation document defines the delivered price to include "every home delivery fee billed on the order", so an allowance taken now would be figured on a price missing the owed charge (328.64-type answer) and would violate the visible principle.
- No hop was pre-solved: the blocked document names no other tool, no route, no ordered list.
